$comment: TRACKED project settings, so a single-repo Claude Code session (cloud or local) inherits
the working agreement without anyone re-explaining it.
The git pre-commit hook is NOT configured here. It is husky + lint-staged:
lint-staged.config.mjs  -> eslint --fix + prettier --write on staged source
Both are tracked, and package.json has `prepare: husky` with husky as a devDependency,
so `npm ci` in a fresh clone installs the hook. It carries over on its own.
What does NOT carry to a cloud session: ~/.claude/settings.json, ~/.claude/skills/*,
and installed plugins (the firebase plugin that supplies the Firestore/App Hosting MCP
tools is account-level and must be enabled by Ahmed). See CLAUDE.md section 13.
$denyRationale: Deploys are denied outright in a session because .github/workflows/deploy.yml is the
only path to production: three separately-approved jobs in the order indexes -> app ->
rules. Rules last is a safety property, not a preference — enforcing the
date-is-timestamp contract before the app is serving the writer that satisfies it breaks
invoice creation, including new-tenant onboarding, for anyone on the old bundle.
The credential files are deny-read because they are real secrets that happen to sit in
the working directory; .env.local and service-account.json are gitignored and must stay
